changes: Bound real Unreal ApplicationLifecycle component events in both the C++ sample and serialized Blueprint graph.
Shut down immediately and silently on deactivation before suspension; resume through public CreateSession and Connect calls with fresh identity and runtime credentials.
Tested app switches during connected direct/TURN sessions and held pending Connect, with old Server cleanup and preserved client PID.
limitations: Physical iOS acceptance remains deferred; iOS runs use the ARM64 simulator.
App switches with process preservation only; screen lock, OS termination, low-memory eviction and background networking were not validated.
Local HTTPS/direct ICE and TURN UDP; no Wi-Fi/cellular handover, ICE restart or Internet NAT acceptance.
Broader packaged ordering/reliability, limits/backpressure and physical-device acceptance remain open.
Development package sizes are absolute sizes, not Shipping download sizes or measured RTC deltas.
